questions.stem: A shape is moved 4 squares right and 3 squares down. Write this translation as a column vector.
worked: The top number is the move across: right is positive, left is negative, so \(4\).
The bottom number is the move up or down: up is positive, down is negative, so \(-3\).

slip.line: The top number is the move across, the bottom number the move up or down.
Right and up are positive; left and down are negative.

slip.line: \(t^4\) means \(t \times t \times t \times t\): 4 tickets is \(4 \times t\).

questions.stem: A plank is \(x\) cm long. 15 cm is cut off. Write an expression for the length left, in cm.

Take away the 15 cm cut off: \(x - 15\).

slip.line: The order matters: start with the plank, \(x\), and take 15 away.
Cutting off makes the plank shorter, so take 15 away.

slip.line: The numbers have swapped: 3 pens is \(3p\) and 2 rulers is \(2r\).

slip.line: That multiplies the length by the width: the perimeter adds the four sides.
There are two widths of 4 cm, so add 8.
That is one length and one width: the perimeter goes all the way round, two of each.

worked: An equilateral triangle has three equal sides.

slip.line: The three sides are each \(y\): \(y + y + y\).
A triangle has three sides.
\(y^3\) is \(y \times y \times y\): the perimeter is \(y + y + y\).

slip.line: That adds the two lengths only: the two widths are needed too.
